# Writing data

```ts
const ann = await User.create({ email: 'ann@example.com' });
await User.bulkCreate([
  { email: 'bob@example.com' },
  { email: 'eve@example.com', active: false },
]);

const byKey = await User.findByPk(ann.id);
const one = await User.findOne({ where: { email: 'bob@example.com' } });
const [cid, created] = await User.findOrCreate({
  where: { email: 'cid@example.com' },
  defaults: { active: true },
});
const all = await User.findAll({ where: { active: true }, order: [['email', 'ASC']], limit: 10 });
const total = await User.count();

ann.active = false; // change tracking: save() writes only changed attributes
await ann.save();
await ann.update({ email: 'ann@corp.example.com' });
await ann.reload();
await User.update({ active: true }, { where: { email: { [Op.like]: '%@example.com' } } });
await User.destroy({ where: { id: cid.id } }); // paranoid models soft-delete; { force: true } removes
```

## Hooks

```ts
const log: string[] = [];
User.beforeCreate((user: User) => {
  user.email = user.email.toLowerCase();
});
User.addHook('afterUpdate', 'log-update', (user: User) => {
  log.push(`updated ${user.id}`);
});
const mixed = await User.create({ email: 'MiXed@Example.com' });
await mixed.update({ active: false });
```

Order for `create`: `beforeValidate`, `afterValidate` (or `validationFailed`), `beforeCreate`, `afterCreate`. Bulk operations run row hooks only with `individualHooks: true`; `hooks: false` skips hooks for one call.

## Validation

```ts
const Person = sequelize.define(
  'Person',
  {
    email: { type: DataTypes.TEXT, allowNull: false, validate: { isEmail: true } },
    name: {
      type: DataTypes.TEXT,
      validate: { len: { args: [2, 50], msg: 'name must be 2-50 characters' } },
    },
    age: {
      type: DataTypes.INTEGER,
      validate: {
        isAdult(value: unknown) {
          if (typeof value === 'number' && value < 18) {
            throw new Error('must be an adult');
          }
        },
      },
    },
  },
  {
    validate: {
      nameOrEmail(this: { name: string | null; email: string | null }) {
        if (this.name === null && this.email === null) {
          throw new Error('name or email is required');
        }
      },
    },
  },
);
```

Standard Schema (zod, valibot, arktype) is supported through `validate: { schema }` and the `validationSchema` model option.

## Upserts and RETURNING

```ts
const [row] = await User.upsert({ id: ann.id, email: 'ann@corp.example.com', active: true });
// v6 shape: [instance, null]; pass onConflict to get a real inserted/updated boolean
const [visit, wasInserted] = await User.upsert(
  { email: 'new@example.com' },
  { onConflict: { target: ['email'], action: { update: { active: true } } } },
);
const written = await User.insert(
  [{ email: 'new@example.com' }, { email: 'other@example.com' }],
  { onConflict: { target: ['email'], action: 'nothing' } },
); // returns the rows that were actually inserted
const [changed, updated = []] = await User.update(
  { active: false },
  { where: { email: 'new@example.com' }, returning: true },
);
```

```ts
const newer = await Counter.insert(
  [
    { tenant: 't1', key: 'a', hits: 100, version: 2 },
    { tenant: 't1', key: 'b', hits: 100, version: 3 },
  ],
  {
    onConflict: {
      target: ['tenant', 'key'],
      action: {
        update: ['hits', 'version'],
        where: { version: { [Op.lt]: excluded('version') } },
      },
    },
  },
);
// only 'a' is updated: 'b' already has version 5; rows that were skipped are not returned
```

```ts
await Counter.bulkCreate([{ tenant: 't1', key: 'a', tags: ['y'] }], {
  onConflict: {
    target: { constraint: 'counters_tenant_key' },
    action: { update: { tags: fn('array_cat', col('Counter.tags'), excluded('tags')) } },
  },
});

const [partial] = await Counter.insert(
  { tenant: 't9', key: 'c', hits: 50 },
  {
    onConflict: {
      target: { columns: ['key'], where: { archived: false } },
      action: { update: { hits: excluded('hits') } },
    },
  },
);
// partial.tenant === 't1': the existing active row with key 'c' was updated

const skipped = await Counter.bulkCreate(
  [
    { tenant: 't1', key: 'b' },
    { tenant: 't1', key: 'n' },
  ],
  { onConflict: { action: 'nothing' } },
);
// skipped: only the inserted row 'n'
```

## UPDATE FROM, DELETE USING, INSERT FROM

```ts
const [updated] = await Stock.update(
  { qty: literal('"Stock"."qty" + "d"."amount"') },
  { where: { sku: col('d.sku') }, from: { d: Delivery } },
);
// UPDATE "Stocks" AS "Stock" SET ... FROM "Deliveries" AS "d" WHERE "Stock"."sku" = "d"."sku"
```

```ts
const archived = await Archive.insertFrom(
  Stock.subquery({ attributes: ['sku', 'qty'], where: { qty: { [Op.gt]: 20 } } }),
  { columns: ['sku', 'qty'] },
);
```

```ts
const removed = await Stock.destroy({
  where: { sku: col('a.sku') },
  using: { a: Archive },
});
```

## COPY (large imports and exports)

```ts
const fromArray = await Event.copyFrom([
  { kind: 'signup', payload: { plan: 'pro' }, tags: ['web'] },
  { kind: 'login', payload: null, tags: null },
]);

const fromStream = await Event.copyFrom(readEvents(), { columns: ['kind', 'payload'] });
// fromArray === 2, fromStream === 1000; createdAt / updatedAt are filled in
```

```ts
const chunks: Buffer[] = [];
for await (const chunk of Event.copyTo({
  attributes: ['id', 'kind', 'tags'],
  where: { kind: { [Op.in]: ['signup', 'login'] } },
  order: [['id', 'ASC']],
  format: 'csv',
  header: true,
})) {
  chunks.push(chunk);
}
const csv = Buffer.concat(chunks).toString('utf8');
// id,kind,tags
// 1,signup,{web}
// 2,login,
```
